msg.content: 1 2 3 # Application Framework 4 5 All-in-one PHP framework and UI layer for building web and intranet 6 applications. 7 8 ## Introduction 9 10 The framework is designed to be a solid foundation for custom-built web 11 applications. The integrated functionality helps to focus on the application 12 logic, while being able to create the necessary administration screens, 13 APIs and more with minimal effort. 14 15 Note that it is not a CMS: it is exclusively a tool for building custom 16 applications. Supporting features are available out of the box, like the 17 notepad or image library, but anything your application needs to do must 18 be implemented by you. 19 20 One of the core functionalities of the framework is to provide an extensive 21 ecology of classes for accessing custom data stored in the database. 22 This includes complex filtering capabilities as well as a versioning 23 system with record state tracking (draft, published, etc.). 24 25 ## Features overview 26 27 - PHP helper classes for UI elements 28 - Form building system - every screen is a form 29 - Rule-based application environment detection 30 - Advanced database-stored data handling tools 31 - Class-based extensible templating system 32 - Localization system for UI translation 33 - News central (release notes, etc.) 34 - Event handling system 35 - Image media library and UI 36 - Tagging system and UI 37 - Versioning system with state tracking 38 - Disposables system for automated garbage collection 39 - API response caching (file-based, opt-in via Interface + Trait; TTL and manual strategies) 40 - SSO via CAS 41 - Interface Translations: English, German, French 42 - Build-time module documentation generators (Modules Overview, Keyword Glossary) 43 - Own ecology of supporting libraries 44 45 ## Requirements 46 47 - PHP 7.4 or higher (fully PHP 8 compatible) 48 - [Composer](https://getcomposer.org) 49 - MariaDB or MySQL database with InnoDB support 50 - Webserver
